datasets.title: LoRadar: A Raw IQ Dataset of Satellite-Ground LoRa Communication Signals

license.landing_page_observation: Current Zenodo Rights > License field is blank
license.action_required: Inspect archive README/license or obtain explicit permission before redistribution

format.container: split ZIP archives containing raw binary files

datasets.subset_rule: Do not download all data by default. First inventory the publisher record, README, checksums, archive/member structure, and any available file index; determine whether selective acquisition is possible. Then deterministically stratify over all five documented PHY configurations, multiple collection sessions/dates, and SNR/Doppler regimes. Prefer whole sessions or packet units so temporal correlations are preserved; commit exact archive part/file/member selection and counts before evaluation.

acquisition_strategy.volume_interpretation: 127 GB is the raw-IQ volume described by the dataset README; the larger Zenodo record volume is not assumed to be equivalent and must be inventoried before acquisition scope is fixed.
selection_basis: whole-session or whole-packet temporal units where practical
acquisition_strategy.packet_level_use: Communication metrics only where transmitted/reference ground truth can be established and validated.
acquisition_strategy.session_level_use: Temporal/channel analysis including Doppler evolution, frequency/amplitude evolution, temporal correlation, packet spacing, and memory-timescale characterization.

datasets.reason_for_tier: Independent physical regime: satellite-ground LoRa, LEO Doppler, different band and SDR hardware, long sessions, real traffic. Tests whether findings survive a major regime change.

datasets.subset_rule: Optional stress set: complete records from multiple spacecraft passes and antenna channels; preserve full-record boundaries in first use.
datasets.reason_for_tier: Specialized raw-IF stress test outside convenient complex-baseband terrestrial communication data; useful for ingestion/robustness but not required for the minimum Paper-1 evidence.

acquisition_strategy.physical_acquisition_environment: Network-enabled VM, workstation, server, or other reliable external acquisition environment; ordinary CI must not download full third-party physical datasets.
acquisition_strategy.physical_gate: No physical dataset is frozen until the actual bytes have been acquired, publisher checksums verified, local SHA-256 recorded, inventory produced, and exact deterministic subset committed.
acquisition_strategy.ci_boundary: CI validates manifests, deterministic selection logic, and local fixtures; it does not acquire or store third-party raw archives.

paper_1_minimum_set.rationale: Two synthetic controls plus two materially different physical regimes provides a small, coverage-driven evidence set without requiring bulk download of large archives. Physical generalization requires both Tier-1 regimes.
